uv_policy: UV0 per-face metric planar projections; overlaps intentionally allowed for prototype tile surfaces; no production atlas or lightmap UVs
collision_policy: Source-owned convex UCX on structural units; no enclosing whole-house hull. Decorative meshes have no collision.
prototype_assumptions: Three 7x8m one-storey houses; 3.9m wall crown; 5.0/5.4m roof tops; 9m facade-to-facade street
1.5x2.45m structural door apertures, 1.3x2.3m tested central clearance
interface: 0.1 study assembly, not a production snap kit. No compatibility with R255. Component bases/pivots and placements form the provisional interface.
